messages:
sam (sales): Heads-up: Jordan (Acme) POC is failing on the embedding->rerank flow. They hit a 400 dims mismatch and intermittent 429s. Logs pasted below, can eng/devex swarm?

zoe (sales-eng): +1. Customer blocked on ranking accuracy tests. They batch ~200 items per request.

maria (eng-ml): Can you paste the exact error from the rerank service? Is the customer sending precomputed embeddings or raw docs?

sam (sales): They said they precompute embeddings with another vendor and POST to /rerank. Error: 
```
{"error":"BadRequest", "message":"embedding dimension mismatch: expected 768, got 1024"}
```
Also earlier we saw 429s in the gateway: `HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests` with `x-rate-limit-reset: 15` in header.

ben (eng-platform): Two separate issues here: dims mismatch (client sent 1024 vectors but our reranker expects 768) and rate limiting from high concurrent batches. If they're batching 200 vectors per request, payload size might blow our per-request size limit. Any chance they're sending float32 arrays encoded as JSON?

li (devex): If they're precomputing, they need to use the same model/encoder we expect. Quick checklist to send Jordan: 
- Confirm embed model name used to produce embeddings (should be redwood/emb-768-v1 or compatible)
- If using third-party embeddings, get a sample vector to check length and dtype (float32 vs float16)
- For large batches, recommend chunking to 32-64 items per request and enable our streaming/batch endpoint if available

maria (eng-ml): Re: dtype/encoding: our reranker accepts base64-encoded binary blocks of float32 or a JSON array of floats. If they send nested lists of floats and size balloons, parsing can hit body size limits. Ask them to send a single sample payload for us to inspect.

sam (sales): Pasting customer sample (sanitized) below: 
```
POST /rerank
{
  "model": "rerank-base",
  "query_embedding": [0.12, -0.03, ... 1024 floats total ...],
  "candidate_embeddings": [[...], [...], ...]  // each candidate 1024 dims
}
```

maria (eng-ml): Yup, that's the root cause — embeddings are 1024. Our rerank-base is pinned to 768-dim embeddings. Two options:
1) Recompute embeddings with redwood/emb-768-v1 (recommended)
2) Use a compatibility shim to project 1024->768 (we can offer a temporary in-service projection, lower quality)

ben (eng-platform): For the 429s: their client is sending 6 concurrent batch requests x ~200 items each during startup. Our default quota for free-tier POC is conservative. Sophie, can we bump their per-minute bursts for a day?

sophie (eng-sre): I can open a temp quota increase: bump concurrent request limit to 12 and per-minute tokens for Acme POC for 24 hours. Need the account ID and start/end window. Also suggest they throttle/retry with exponential backoff and honor `Retry-After`.

li (devex): I'll draft a short runbook for Jordan: include a small curl sample to validate dims and a chunking example. Putting sample here:
```
# Quick validate dims
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/embed/validate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"embedding": [0.12, -0.03, ...]}'
# Chunking example (pseudo)
for chunk in chunks(candidates_list, 64):
  POST /rerank with chunk
```

sam (sales): Jordan asked if this is a pricing or product limitation. Can we confirm if larger dim embeddings are supported on Dedicated?

ben (eng-platform): Dedicated pools can be configured to accept custom dimensions but it requires model onboarding or a compatibility layer. It's not a self-serve toggle right now. For the POC we should steer them to recompute with the 768 model. If they need 1024 long-term we can scope a Dedicated config + onboarding.

maria (eng-ml): Quick mitigation: If they can't recompute now, we can enable the projection shim for the account as a short-term workaround. Lower quality warning attached. That avoids downtimes for the POC tests.

sophie (eng-sre): Quota increase ready to go once Sam DM's me the account id. Also set `Retry-After` logic and reduce client concurrency from 6->2 for now.

zoe (sales-eng): I'll send Jordan an action plan: 1) validate dims, 2) chunk to 32-64, 3) retry/backoff, 4) option to recompute embeddings with our model or request temp shim. Include timeline for Dedicated if needed.

sam (sales): Great. Zoe/Triage: can you send the runbook and ask for a sanitized sample vector (first 16 floats) so eng can verify quickly? I'll DM Sophie the account id.

deploy-bot: ENV deploy:quota-adjust v1 triggered by sophie at 1764123400 — temporary quota increase scheduled (24h). :rocket:

maria (eng-ml): I'll prepare a small projection shim spec in case they need it. Will post link once done.

li (devex): I'll follow up with the curl examples + a short note about encoding pitfalls (don't stringify binary, use base64 for compactness).

sam (sales): Thanks team — keeping this open until Jordan verifies. :thumbsup:
